rules.stage_b: Per family, choose the Stage-A S2_P50 hit ratio closest to the family median; tie-break by lower length_level, then stable case_id.
rules.stage_b2: For every family choose the fixed length_level=1 and length_level=8 endpoints.
rules.stage_c: Use all 16 Stage-B representatives, then four lowest-hit and four highest-hit Stage-A prompts not already selected; stable case_id breaks equal-hit ties.
